scripts.text: Therefore, in order to enter ^006400Memorial Dungeon^000000, the Party Leader must apply to enter. Since you enter in the order you apply, you must be on stand-by to enter.
scripts.translation: 进入记忆地下城前，必须由队长提出申请。入场顺序按申请先后排列，所以申请后要在一旁等候。 ^006400^000000

scripts.text: Also, after you explore Memorial Dungeon, you cannot re-enter the same ^006400Memorial Dungeon^000000 for a certain period of time.
scripts.translation: 另外，完成一次记忆地下城后，需要等待一段时间才能再次进入同一个记忆地下城。 ^006400^000000

scripts.text: Many ^006400Memorial Dungeon^000000s exist, but we will give you hints to help you find Memorial Dungeon in the world of Midgard.
scripts.translation: 米德加尔特有许多记忆地下城。我们会给你一些线索，告诉你该去哪里找。 ^006400^000000

scripts.text: First, go to ^8B4513Alberta^000000 and find ^006400Captain Jansen^000000.
He will give you information about the really huge and tall dungeon known as ^006400Endless Tower^000000.
scripts.translation: 长。他会告诉你那座高耸巨大的迷宫——无尽之塔的相关情报。 ^006400^000000

scripts.text: Second, go to the ^8B4513Orc Map^000000 where all the orcs live and find the ^006400Insane Scientist^000000.
You might be able to get some information about a dungeon that has to do with ^006400Orc's Memory^000000.
scripts.translation: 0000。他或许能提供与兽人记忆有关的地下城情报。 ^006400^000000

scripts.text: Third and last, seek out the place where you can become a monk, which is the ^8B4513Capitolina Monastery^000000 and seek out ^006400Detective Patrick^000000.
scripts.translation: 最后，前往武僧修行之地圣卡波利纳修道院，寻找侦探帕特里克。 ^8B4513^000000^006400^000000

scripts.text: He will be able to give you information about the dungeon with the ^006400Sealed Baphomet^000000+.
scripts.translation: 他会告诉你封印着巴风特的地下城的情报+。 ^006400^000000

scripts.text: Of course there are other locations for Memorial Dungeon but it's best to start where you can find it easily.
scripts.translation: 当然，记忆地下城还有其他地点，不过最好先从容易找到的地方开始

scripts.text: As you continue to go on your adventures you will be able to find them more easily.
scripts.translation: 。随着冒险经验增加，你会越来越容易发现它们。

scripts.text: Seeing that you came to me, I assume you have some questions about ^006400MAP^000000s?
scripts.translation: 你特地来找我，想必是想了解地图吧？ ^006400^000000

scripts.text: If you end up in those areas while you're adventuring, be sure to tell me all about it!
scripts.translation: 冒险时要是去了那些地方，记得回来告诉我！现在你已经通

scripts.text: And now, since you've passed all the Expert's quizzes, go on and talk to ^006400Tutorial Goal^000000.
scripts.translation: 过了所有专家的测验，去找教学目标吧。 ^006400^000000

scripts.text: If you have any more questions, come find me.
scripts.translation: 还有问题的话，随时来找我。

scripts.text: I have been researching and studying ^006400MAP^000000s for 16 years and so now I am the ^006400MAP^000000 Expert!
Since you've sought me out, it seems you've passed ^006400Memorial Dungeon Expert^000000's quiz.
scripts.translation: ！既然你来找我，看来已经通过记忆地下城专家的测验了。 ^006400^000000

scripts.text: As you already know, if you pass all the Experts' quiz you'll get a prize.
scripts.translation: 你应该已经知道，通过所有专家的测验就能获得奖励。

scripts.text: As the last Expert, I will try to explain everything about ^006400MAP^000000s to make it easy on you. Ready to start?
scripts.translation: 作为最后一位专家，我会尽量把地图相关内容讲得简单易懂。准备好了吗？ ^006400^000000

scripts.text: How was my explanation? Now I am gonna give you a quick quiz! You have to get all the answers correct in order to pass. Ready?
scripts.translation: 我的讲解怎么样？接下来给你做个小测验，全部答对才能通过。准备好了吗？

scripts.translation: 以后想多了解地图的话，随时来找我。 ^006400^000000

scripts.translation: 恭喜通过所有专家的测验！现在去找教学目标聊聊吧！ ^006400^000000

scripts.text: The 3 questions shouldn't have been that hard...
scripts.translation: 那三道题本来不该这么难...

scripts.text: Well, you seem to be pretty smart so why not try the quiz again?
scripts.translation: 你看起来挺聪明的，再试一次测验吧？

scripts.translation: 我的讲解怎么样？接下来给你出几道小测验，全部答对才能通过。想试试吗？

scripts.text: I'm the last Expert! Dont' give up! Come find me again when you're ready!
scripts.translation: 我是最后一位专家！别放弃！准备好后再来找我！

scripts.text: You're gonna give up without even trying? But I'm the last Expert! Dont' give up! Come find me again when you're ready!
scripts.translation: 还没试就要放弃吗？我可是最后一位专家！别放弃，准备好后再来找我！

scripts.text: If you want to learn from me, go get acknowledged by the ^006400Memorial Dungeon^000000 first.
scripts.translation: 想跟我学习的话，先去获得记忆地下城的认可。 ^006400^000000

scripts.text: A ^006400MAP^000000 shows you things that is much needed for travelling around the world; such as the lay of the land, major towns and fields and such. It's a very important tool!
scripts.translation: 地图会显示你在世界各地旅行时需要的信息，例如地形、主要城镇和原野等，是非常重要的工具！ ^006400^000000

scripts.text: Because of this, it's more important than everything else that you know about ^006400MAP^000000s.
scripts.translation: 正因如此，了解地图比其他事情都重要。 ^006400^000000

scripts.text: The map can be accessed by clicking on the button that says ^006400MAP^000000 on the upper left side of your screen.
scripts.translation: 点击屏幕左上角标有地图的按钮，就能打开地图。 ^006400^000000

scripts.text: When you click on the ^006400MAP^000000 button, a full sized map of Midgard will take up your screen.
scripts.translation: 点击地图按钮后，米德加尔特的完整地图就会显示在屏幕上。 ^006400^000000

scripts.text: When you ^0000FFHover your mouse over specific areas^000000, you can find out more things such as ^006400NAME^000000 and Area Details.
scripts.translation: 把鼠标悬停在特定区域上，还能查看名称和区域详情等信息。 ^0000FF^000000^006400^000000

scripts.text: If you look to the lower right side of your map, there is a ^006400Poring drawing^000000.

scripts.translation: 击图标或按TAB键，就能查看各种信息。 ^006400^000000

scripts.text: Firstly, you can find out the ^006400NAME^000000 and ^006400LEVEL^000000 of the monsters in each area. That will take a lot of the guess work out of where you want to go hunt.
scripts.translation: 首先，你能查看各区域魔物的名称和等级，方便判断该去哪里狩猎。 ^006400^000000^006400^000000

scripts.translation: 等级，相关信息会以红色标出，方便查看。 ^006400^000000

scripts.text: Currently, we cannot see places that are beyond Midgard but it has been said that there are a lot of unknown worlds that exist in the beyond.
scripts.translation: 目前我们还看不到米德加尔特以外的地方，不过听说远方还有许多未知世界。
